lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiCuO₂ crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P-6m2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing four atoms across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Li centers have three O neighbors and O centers have three neighbors (one Cu, two Li). The Cu octahedra share edges with one another and with Li 3-vertex polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
